name: California Highway Patrol Explorer Program
what_you_do: Teens in Explorer posts train in law enforcement skills and can compete at the CHP statewide Explorer competition in West Sacramento. Contact CHP to find a post.
who_can_apply: The 2026 competition packet says ages 15 to 21. The official page does not list local post rules like GPA or background checks, so ask the Explorer office.
pay_detail: No pay is stated on the official page. The 2026 state competition cost $150 per explorer, paid by the team.
duration: Not stated. The state competition was April 25 to 26, 2026.
deadline_text: No sign-up dates for joining a post are posted. The 2026 state competition (April 25 to 26, 2026) has passed.
how_to_apply: Email CHPExplorers@chp.ca.gov or call (916) 843-3210 to ask how to join a post near you.
notes: The official CHP page is mostly about the statewide competition, not how a teen joins a post. Age 15 to 21 comes from the competition packet. Whether a post near you exists, and any background check or GPA rule, must be confirmed with CHP.
